title: Cantrip set
html:
The Cantrip set enhances damaging cantrips or grants access to them. Synergizes with items from the Elemental set and Sparkstruck set, which are not duplicated here.

Name Slot Effect

Circlet of Mental Anguish 		 Headgear (Non-Armour)
Psychic Leech
When an enemy fails a  Charisma,  Intelligence, or  Wisdom  Saving throw against one of your spells or cantrips, you regain 1d4⁠⁠hit points.

Gemini Gloves 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
Adroit Caster
Cantrips targeting foes and allies can target an additional creature. The same target can be chosen twice. Usable once per short rest.

Gold Wyrmling Staff 		 Main Hand Melee (Quarterstaff)
  • Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage.
 Fire Bolt ()
Hurl a mote of fire.

Helldusk Gloves 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
  • Strength  Saving Throws +1
 Rays of Fire ()
Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals 3d6Fire damage. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
Infernal Acuity
You gain +1 bonus to Spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC.
Infernal Touch
Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict  Bleeding.

Hellfire Greataxe 		 Main Hand Melee (Greataxe)
  • Deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage.
Thermodynamo
Whenever you deal damage with this weapon, you gain 2 turns of  Heat.
Hellflame Cleave ()

Spew hellish flames and strike your foes.


Incandescent Staff 		 Main Hand Melee (Quarterstaff)
  • Ranged Spell Attack + 1.
  • Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
 Fire Bolt ()
Hurl a mote of fire.
 Fireball ( + )
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

Moon Devotion Robe 		 Armour (Clothing)
  •  Advantage on Constitution  Saving Throws.
  •  Saving Throws +1
 Lunar Bulwark ()
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
 Produce Flame ()
A flame in your hand sheds a light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius and deals 1d8⁠⁠Fire damage when thrown.
Selûne's Protection
While the wearer has  Mage Armour, each successful  Saving Throw causes the source of the Saving Throw to take 1d4⁠⁠Radiant damage.

Mourning Frost 		 Main Hand Melee (Quarterstaff)
  • Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Cold damage.
Heart of Ice
When dealing ⁠Cold damage, the wielder deals an additional 1⁠⁠Cold.
Insidious Cold
Dealing Cold damage with a spell possibly inflicts  Chilled upon the target.
 Ray of Frost ()
Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 3 m / 10 ft.

Potent Robe 		 Armour (Clothing)
  •  Armour Class +1
Gregarious Caster
Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your Charisma Modifier.
Well-Liked and Well-Fortified
At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the robe activates, granting them Temporary Hit Points equal to their Charisma Modifier.

Quickspell Gloves 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
Quickspell Flinger
Cantrips that cost an  Action cost a  Bonus Action instead. This effect can be used once per Short Rest.

Ring of Arcane Synergy 		 Ring
Synergetic Cantrips
When you deal damage with a Cantrip, you gain  Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.

Sorrow 		 Main Hand Melee (Glaive)
 Sorrowful Lash ()
Pulls the creature 3 m / 10 ft closer to you. ( Recharge: Per turn.)

Spellseeking Gloves 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
Seeking Spell
When you make a Spell Attack Roll, you can spend a  Sorcery Point to gain  Advantage. This costs 1 Sorcery Point per spell slot Level. Cantrips cost 1 Sorcery Point.

Staff of a Mumbling Wizard 		 Main Hand Melee (Quarterstaff)
 Firebolt? ()
Hurl a mote of fire.
Has a 1/20 chance to cast  Fireball instead.
